name: vscode-markdownlint
description: Markdown linting and style checking for Visual Studio Code
readme:
# markdownlint

Markdown linting and style checking: violations in Problems and as you type, quick fixes, fix on save and a task that lints the whole workspace. The linter is bundled, nothing else to install.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.

works: Diagnostics in Problems and in the editor, while typing
Quick fixes, Format Document, fix on save and the fix all command
Lint Workspace task, focus mode, toggling linting and live reload of the config file
limits: The markdownlint-disable comment snippets are not offered: Diode has no extension snippets so far
